registration.heading: Thank you for a wonderful BBSW 2026!
registration.note: BBSW 2026 is a wrap. Thank you to everyone who joined us in Foster City: our speakers and session chairs, poster presenters, sponsors and partners, volunteers, and every attendee who made this sold-out conference such a lively exchange of ideas. Slides that speakers have chosen to share are now available in the conference app. We hope to see you at BBSW 2027!

app.title: BBSW 2026 Conference App
app.text: The conference app stays online: browse the full program and speakers, see the poster award winners, and download the slides that speakers have shared.
app.qrCaption: Scan to open on your phone
